selection: Fixed eight language-representation/model papers selected before new abstract responses, labels or model predictions. Reject normalized title/arXiv ID overlap with the entire 20000-paper registry, old train/dev references and original train/dev/test selection metadata; no replacement after failure. This is a targeted external development slice, not a random population sample or final test.
collection: Reuse official arXiv citation metadata parser and bounded HTTP client; retain original HTML and Unicode abstract, verify title/ID, respect current robots and serial delay >=15.1s, reject >512 tokens without truncation.
annotation: Reuse current METHOD/TASK/DATASET boundaries and explicit attribution/role-contrast relation policy. Actual AI generation followed by actual same-session source review. No model predictions are annotation inputs; UNRESOLVED never defaults to NO_RELATION. Preserve missing/quarantined documents in the denominator.
evaluation: Separate supplementary-development denominators and bias disclosures. Never relabel or overwrite old dev/test, backfill historical F1 or count supplement as production papers. No independent human/model gold claim. Old promotion gates are unchanged; new scores require a separate frozen comparison lock.
